title: A Formal Email
text:
Dear Mr. Smith, I am writing to ask about the job in your company. I saw the advertisement on the website last week. I have three years of experience in sales.

I would like to know the start date and the working hours. Please reply to me by email. Thank you for your time. Kind regards, Ana.

questions.text: Why is the writer sending the email?
What does the writer want to know in the second paragraph?
options: The start date and the working hours

questions.text: What can we infer about the writer?
options: They want to work for this company
They do not like the company
They are the manager of the company

questions.text: Why does the writer end with 'Kind regards'?
options: To show that they are angry
To invite the reader to a party

vocabulary.definition: a public notice that promotes a job, product or service
knowledge or skills gained from doing a job or activity
to write or say something back to someone
the times of day when a person works

paragraph_translations: Caro Sr. Smith, escrevo para perguntar sobre a vaga na sua empresa. Eu vi o anúncio no site na semana passada. Tenho três anos de experiência em vendas.
Gostaria de saber a data de início e o horário de trabalho. Por favor, responda ao meu e-mail. Obrigada pelo seu tempo. Atenciosamente, Ana.
